newsitem.title: FRANCE: France frustrated in Zaire diplomat trial plea.
newsitem.headline: France frustrated in Zaire diplomat trial plea.

text.p: France voiced frustration on Tuesday at Zaire's failure to lift the diplomatic immunity of its ambassador in Paris so that he can stand trial for killing two French boys with his car.

Framce has vowed to bring envoy Ramazami Baya to justice after his car, travelling at more than twice the legal speed limit, hit two boys on a pedestrian crossing in the Riviera resort of Menton more than a month ago, killing both of them.

Asked about the return of Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko to France earlier this month and the lifting of the ambassador's immunity, Foreign Ministry spokesman Jacques Rummelhardt told reporters: "We are still awaiting for the ambassador's immunity to be lifted, which is something we are still demanding."

The boys' mothers are campaigning to bring Baya to trial for the accident. Relatives plan new demonstrations following Mobutu's return from Zaire to southern France to consult his doctors following treatment for prostate cancer in Switzerland last year.
Before being recalled to Kinshasa, Baya had offered to renounce his immunity. But his government said only it could lift the immunity it had granted him.
